claims.title: Symmetric-assisted capacity and distillation resist uniform approximation

quoted_fields.interface: Using accepted N675 as the stated premise and the N684 genuine complementary-channel machinery,the producer constructs variable-dimensional finite rational channels with Q_ss=0 on nonhalting inputs and Q_ss>=2 bits per constructed-channel use on halting inputs. Uniform additive1/4 approximation of symmetric-side-channel-assisted capacity is therefore source-proved impossible despite additivity,convexity and a single-letter formula. Explicit instance-dependent full-Choi-rank neighborhoods and a completed,probability-accounted Choi filter extend the reported obstruction to symmetric-assisted one-way distillation.
quoted_fields.failure: This does NOT settle additive-approximation computability of ordinary unassisted quantum capacity:the unknown N684 reference-transport block length can destroy a computable rate margin. For fixed input/output dimensions and fixed error,a finite uniform approximate helper cutoff exists;no algorithm selects sufficient cutoffs across the full variable-dimensional domain. No claim that a specified individual rational channel has a noncomputable real capacity. N675 standing acceptance is retained;historical unreviewed/external-gate wording is not reopened. No practical compiler,device or novelty determination.
